algorithm: {For each bin, if it has sufficient capacity to hold the item, compute the priority score as the negative of the remainder when the remaining space in the bin after adding the item is divided by the item's size, otherwise assign a priority of negative infinity.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining_space = bins[valid_mask] - item
    scores[valid_mask] = - (remaining_space % item)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
